text: Arrow added (section 4, pass 2), move sequencing: A18 P09 -> P18, order, strength fair. Connection: in a room carrying both, the room's first call or act against another room's work comes before the first taunt, chant, claim of victory or salute with a rival. Holds in 56 of 68 rooms (0.824) against a null mean of 0.591 (p95 0.676); early 10 of 13, late 0 of 0. Mechanism: An attack makes the rival a named party, and the contest is carried on in talk: taunts, chants, claims of victory, a salute after the fight. Fails if: In a room, rivalry talk comes only before any attack, or an attack is never followed by talk with or about the rival. Sampled against: reddevils holds, nbaspurs holds, cardinals holds, portugal holds. Bound: Early side only: no late-side room carries both.

Arrow added (section 4, pass 2), move sequencing: A19 P05 -> P17, order, strength thin. Connection: in a room carrying both, the first act of upkeep or defence comes before the first alliance, shared chat, joint mark or request to host. Holds in 106 of 157 rooms (0.675) against a null mean of 0.569 (p95 0.631); early 21 of 32, late 2 of 7. Mechanism: A room keeping its work against attack joins other rooms whose works face the same threat, and they defend each other's works together. Fails if: In a room, coalitions come only before any upkeep or defence, or a room under attack never joins with another. Sampled against: torontoraptors holds, corridor holds, bretagne fails, serbia holds. Bound: Late side: 2 of 7 hold; late rooms join a coalition or ask a host first, entering the canvas through other rooms (bretagne, MiamiHurricanes, yuyuyu). Thin: one of twelve order tests at pass 2.
